checks.title: Final settings personalization walkthrough
checks.instructions: After maximum machine QA passes, perform one end-to-end walkthrough: switch Auto/Dupliqué, adjust verbosity and politeness/formality, compare/filter model catalogs, inspect an unavailable model and confirm that no unsupported request/add action is offered, navigate all voice tabs, reload Jarvis/Control Center, and confirm values/state remain coherent.
checks.expected: The new settings architecture persists correctly, never misrepresents availability, and is materially easier to navigate than the removed Aiguillage/dense voice pages.

execution.evidence: Real CUA walkthrough confirmed Agent/CLI and Voice persistence, truthful unavailable catalog states, search and role-state retention, keyboard navigation, responsive layouts, save/reopen behavior, and zero browser console warnings/errors. Unsupported request/add actions were absent.
